title: See the cost before every paid start
summary: See the cost before every paid start, InDesign translation, a new Cosmos builder and workflow assistant, style-guide rules for many languages, folder shortcuts, and Translate Video keeps your video's frame rate and quality.

sections.title: See the cost before you start

items.title: Every paid action now shows its credit cost before it starts.
items.body: Confirm, and the job begins. This covers:

children.body: Image Creator (including Quick Create) and Adapts
Playground, QC and AI quality reports

items.title: Credits are taken when a job starts,
items.body: not when it finishes:

children.body: If a job fails on our side, the credits are **refunded automatically**.
If you cancel, stop or delete a job, the credits are not refunded.

items.title: Not enough credits?
items.body: The start button is disabled and a **Top up** link is shown, so nothing half-starts.

items.title: If your organization owes credits,
items.body: for example because a job ended up costing more than your balance, nothing new can start until you top up. The message tells you how many credits you owe.

items.title: Paused plans can still spend the credits they hold.
Credit Activity is easier to read,
items.body: with short type labels (hover for details) and readable operation names.

items.title: Translate InDesign (.idml) files
items.body: from the new **InDesign Translation** page in Playground. Only the text changes. Styles, layout, links and images stay exactly as they were.

items.title: Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Arabic and other complex scripts render correctly.
items.body: Fonts switch to the matching Noto family, and InDesign's World-Ready composer is turned on so letters join and shape properly.

items.title: Logos and icons are left alone,
items.body: even when the document types them as letters.

items.title: Layout preview in the browser.
items.body: See the translation in its pages and frames. A red box marks any frame where the text no longer fits.
Have an `.indd` file? Export it from InDesign as IDML first (File → Export → InDesign Markup).

sections.title: Cosmos: new builder and workflow assistant

items.title: A new, faster builder.

children.body: Add steps with the **+** picker, or drag from a step to create the next one.
Insert a step on any connection.
Undo/redo, copy/paste, a right-click menu and keyboard shortcuts.

items.title: Lay out top-to-bottom or left-to-right,
items.body: and your choice is remembered.

items.title: Describe a workflow and the assistant builds it.
items.body: Open the assistant panel and type what you need. It proposes steps you can apply or discard, and asks a quick question when something is unclear.

items.title: Runs list.
items.body: Paged, with filters for status, workflow, folder and search.

items.title: Run page.
items.body: A timeline, a live canvas, each step's output, and every step that's waiting on someone.

sections.title: Style guides: one rule at a time

items.title: Each rule can apply to several languages,
items.body: or to all of them. It is saved on its own, so editing one rule never overwrites another.

items.title: Turn a rule off
items.body: without deleting it. Rules that are off are not used in translation.

items.title: Bulk actions:
items.body: add or remove languages, turn rules on or off, or delete them.

items.title: Drag to reorder.
Copy one language's rules to another language.
"All rules" and "All languages" views,
items.body: next to the language dropdown.
Rules that were duplicated across languages have been merged into one rule.
Style-guide files can cover several languages, up to 25 MB each.

items.title: A process created in a Folder now shows its input file in that folder,
items.body: as a shortcut. Deleting the shortcut never deletes the original.

items.title: Choose a Folder when you start a document translation.
items.body: This works in the New Translation window, folder runs, and the Office and Text pages.

items.title: Playground "Save to Assets"
items.body: can now save into any folder inside Playground's own folder.

items.title: Your video keeps its own settings.
items.body: New uploads keep their original frame rate (24, 25, 30…). Exports match the upload's frame rate, sample rate and bitrate instead of fixed presets.

items.title: Uploads are compressed at a higher quality than before,
items.body: so they look closer to the original.

items.title: New setting: Keep original video quality.
items.body: Find it in Settings → Common settings → Translate Video. It is off by default. When it is on, uploads are not compressed at all unless they need repair. This uses more storage.

items.title: The editor timeline follows the video's frame rate,
items.body: so edits land on the same frames as the export.

items.title: STL and EDL subtitle files use the video's real frame rate,
items.body: so timecodes no longer drift.

items.title: AI quality report "Fix all"
items.body: leaves alone any segment you edited after the report ran. It tells you how many it skipped. "Apply fix" on a single segment still works.

items.title: Onboarding:
items.body: your new organization's name and web address are prefilled from your first name. You can still change both.

items.title: InDesign translation: 0.5 credits per source word,
items.body: the same as the other document formats. Hidden layers, text outside the pages, and logo characters are not counted.

items.title: Generate All and bulk emotion in the Translate Video editor are now free.
Translate Video: "We couldn't read this file's length".
items.body: Starting a run from Cosmos or from a file picked in Assets no longer fails with this message.

items.title: Text-to-speech:
items.body: a card deleted in another tab no longer breaks saving in an editor that was already open.

items.title: AI quality report languages:
items.body: with many languages, the language tabs now scroll instead of hiding the buttons.

items.title: The Translation Memory page showed fewer rows than it should
items.body: after translations were deleted, at any page size. Units with no translation left are no longer listed or counted.

items.title: A failed image translation left its spinner running.
items.body: It now stops and shows a clear message.
